answer_1.quote: We select six representative tasks related to spoken language understanding: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Phoneme Recognition (PR), Keyword Spotting (KS), Emotion Recognition (ER), Spoken Intent Classification (IC), and Speech Translation (ST).
answer_1.outputs: transcribed text for ASR tasks, translated text for ST tasks

answer_2.quote: For IC, performance is measured by accuracy, and for ASR, by word error rate (WER).
